def house(x,y,w,h,roof,wall='#b8a07a',trim='#4a3020',lit=True,roofh=None,locked=False,chimney=True,windows=2):
    roofh=roofh or w//2
    wl=C(wall); wd=lerp(wl,(40,30,40),0.45)
    d.rectangle((x,y-h,x+w,y),fill=wl); d.rectangle((x+w*2//3,y-h,x+w,y),fill=wd)        # 오른쪽 면 그늘
    for k in range(0,w,6): d.line((x+k,y-h,x+k,y),fill=C(trim))                         # 나무 기둥
    d.line((x,y-h//2,x+w,y-h//2),fill=C(trim)); d.rectangle((x,y-h,x+w,y),outline=C('#1a1218'))
    r=C(roof); rd=lerp(r,(20,10,30),0.4)
    d.polygon([(x-3,y-h),(x+w//2,y-h-roofh),(x+w+3,y-h)],fill=r)
    d.polygon([(x+w//2,y-h-roofh),(x+w+3,y-h),(x+w//2+2,y-h)],fill=rd)
    for k in range(3,roofh,3):                                                            # 기와 줄
        t=k/roofh; d.line((x+w//2-int(t*(w//2+3)),y-h-roofh+k,x+w//2+int(t*(w//2+3)),y-h-roofh+k),fill=rd)
    d.polygon([(x-3,y-h),(x+w//2,y-h-roofh),(x+w+3,y-h)],outline=C('#1a1218'))
    if chimney:
        d.rectangle((x+w*3//4-2,y-h-roofh//2-8,x+w*3//4+2,y-h-roofh//3),fill=C('#5a4a50'),outline=C('#1a1218'))
    win=[]
    for i in range(windows):
        wx=x+4+i*(w-12)//max(1,windows-1) if windows>1 else x+w//2-2
        for wy in (y-h+4,y-h//2+4):
            d.rectangle((wx,wy,wx+4,wy+5),fill=C('#f0c060') if lit else C('#2a2430'),outline=C('#1a1218'))
            if lit: d.point((wx+1,wy+1),fill=C('#fff0c0')); win.append((wx+2,wy+3))
    d.rectangle((x+w//2-3,y-8,x+w//2+3,y),fill=C('#3a2418') if not locked else C('#1e1820'),outline=C('#1a1218'))
    return win
